text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Shedrach Kiruki is retired as the Commissioner of Police.
- A Senior Superintendent of Police and 11 other officers are charged with the murder of two Kenyatta University students.
- Shareholders of Kenya Planters Co-operative Union (KPCU) reject a move by the directors to have the organisation de-registerd as a co-operative society.
- FORD-Kenya chairman Michael Kijana Wamalwa formally kicks out Raila Odinga from the troubled party and recommends Raila's Langata constituency seat in Nairobi be declared vacant.
- The business-crippling strike by bank employees continues on Friday after Kenya bank employers and the banker's union fail to reach an agreement after a four-hour meeting behind closed doors.
- Five people who appealed against a nine-year jail term for robbery are ordered to hang.
- Ailing Koigi wa Wamwere makes his first public appearance in his hometown Nakuru in the rift valley where he attends a mass service and views the body of his father at the town mortuary.
